_documentation.purpose: Pull a left-bank vortex toward a central TDGL Josephson weak link while an unilluminated same-sign vortex evolves on the opposite bank. Optional AC current enables exploratory microwave/junction locking studies.
_documentation.interpretation: This is a spatial TDGL weak link, not a microscopic tunnel-insulator model. The AC option applies contact current and records junction voltage/phase; a quantitative Shapiro claim requires a bias sweep and comparison with the separate SIS RCSJ model.

fields.simulation_config: Resolved 150 nm by 100 nm two-temperature NbN film with a vertical weak link at x=75 nm.
fields.applied_field_T: Perpendicular background field. Reduce toward zero to isolate the two seeded vortices; increase to study field-driven entry.
fields.initial_vortices: All seeded TDGL vortices. The entry nearest seed_position_m is actively tracked; all others evolve freely with no direct laser controller.
fields.initial_vortices[].charge: Signed phase winding. Use +1 for mutually repelling vortices or -1 for an opposite-bank antivortex experiment.
fields.initial_vortices[].x_fraction: Initial x position as a fraction of film width.
fields.initial_vortices[].y_fraction: Initial y position as a fraction of film height.
fields.initial_vortices[].core_radius_cells: Numerical seeded-core radius in mesh cells.
fields.seed_position_m: Reference position selecting the left-bank vortex as the controlled identity.
fields.target.displacement_m: Desired motion of the tracked vortex. +30 nm in x brings it to about 7.5 nm from the weak-link center.
fields.target.tolerance_nm: Distance from the destination that stops the run successfully.
fields.laser.absorbed_power_W: Absorbed optical heating power while thermal hysteresis permits illumination.
fields.laser.offset_m: Beam lead relative to the tracked vortex; positive x pulls it toward the junction.
fields.laser.update_every_steps: Accepted TDGL steps between feedback updates.
fields.electrical_drive.enabled: Enable left-to-right DC plus sinusoidal AC contact current. False isolates laser and vortex-junction dynamics.
fields.electrical_drive.dc_current_A: DC current bias used to scan the junction voltage response.
fields.electrical_drive.frequency_Hz: Drive frequency; 50 GHz gives five cycles in a 100 ps, 10,000-step segment.
fields.tracking.require_unique_topology: False permits the controlled vortex to be followed in the presence of the opposite-bank and field-entered vortices.
fields.tracking.initial_search_radius_m: Radius used once after dark preparation to reacquire the selected seed; it may be much larger than the per-step jump gate.
fields.tracking.maximum_jump_m: Largest accepted one-step movement before identity is considered unresolved.
fields.thermal_control: Peak-electron-temperature hysteresis keeps the complete film below the configured hard limit.
fields.timing.dark_steps: Laser-off preparation steps before feedback begins.
fields.timing.max_steps: Maximum transport steps. At 0.01 ps per step, 20,000 steps equals 200 ps.
fields.timing.sample_every: Diagnostic cadence; voltage and phase are recorded at this interval.
fields.output.field_snapshot_every: Raw field-frame cadence for later GIFs and multivortex analysis.
fields.live_preview: Optional four-panel preview updated during the active run.
fields.profiling.enabled: Measure wall-time use by solver and output subsystems.
